decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)
scale 0–10 by 2 (capped at the theoretical maximum)
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, North slot 2, Central slot 3, West slot 4
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: East moved 0.28 line heights, North moved 0.28 line heights, Central moved 0.43 line heights, West moved 0.43 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: North; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the line of East): “average rating out of 10”; “10” stays on the top label
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
comment 1 (“A new manager started in North in Janua…”) in empty space inside the plot, 1 arrow to north at 2022-01 (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title; what explains it: comment 1 (not answered: why care, what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)
notes under the chart, below everything else, left-aligned and wrapped to its 368 pt: a on “average rating out of 10”; b on “North”, “in North in January”; 1 plain note (marks in reading order)

source.shows: footnotes on an end label (room kept at the plot's right) and on a comment's last line, sharing one mark; on the unit phrase; a plain note
